_comment: Auto-registers Playwright MCP so Claude Code can drive a browser, read console errors, capture screenshots, and verify UI changes without the user copy-pasting screenshots. Run 'npx @playwright/mcp install' once after cloning. Headless by default — flip headless to false for debugging visually. DEV_URL points at prod because Athena has no local dev server running by default; flip to http://localhost:3000 when you spin one up.
